plans.idea: Editorial left column: headline, intro and the three numbered steps stack as one tall block on the left 62%, the CTA sits under it on the same left edge, and the right side stays open for the background circle, as in the original.
Banner read left to right: the full copy block fills a wide left panel and the CTA stands alone, vertically centred in a right-hand action column, so the eye goes headline, steps, then action.

Wide stage: the text spans almost the full width so the headline can be large and the step lines stay short, with a bottom band that puts the legal text on the left and the CTA on the right on one baseline.
